explanation: Conditional moves are instructions that perform an operation only if a certain condition is met.  They improve performance by avoiding the pipeline stalls associated with conditional branches. In pipelined processors, branches disrupt the flow of instructions, causing delays. Conditional moves allow the processor to continue processing instructions in parallel, even when the outcome of a comparison is unknown, leading to faster execution.
